name: com.opensubtitles/mcp-server
title: OpenSubtitles
description: Search, inspect and download subtitles for movies and TV from OpenSubtitles.com.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSUBTITLES_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional own OpenSubtitles API key (https://www.opensubtitles.com/consumers); a built-in app key is used otherwise

environmentVariables.name: OPENSUBTITLES_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your OpenSubtitles username, for your account's download quota and VIP status

headers.name: X-OpenSubtitles-Username
headers.description: Your OpenSubtitles username; with the password, enables downloads on your account's quota

headers.name: X-OpenSubtitles-Token
headers.description: Alternative to username/password: a login token from the OpenSubtitles API
